thread:
Maria (CSE): quick sync: BlueForge onboarding spike — multiple QA browsers cause bursts of 429s on embeddings. saw it during parallel test runs.
Jordan (Dev): which SDK + token pattern?
Maria (CSE): web-embed-sdk v0.8.2, ephemeral tokens rotated ~30s, batch size=1, many tabs -> fanout. 429 payload shows retry_after=3.
Sam (Eng): are these POST 429s or preflight?
Maria (CSE): POSTs primarily. preflight visible but main failures are POST 429s.
Jordan (Dev): repro curl?
Maria (CSE): shared this: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H \"Authorization: Bearer <EPHEMERAL>\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-embed-1\",\"input\":\[\"test\"\]}'`
Evan (SRE): pattern: many short-lived tokens + tab fanout => backend sees too many unique auth contexts, connection churn prevents keep-alive reuse. mitigations: temporary rate bump, encourage token reuse per session, or server-side proxy.
Maria (CSE): customer ok with temporary bump for tomorrow morning ramp. Account BG-1234.
Evan (SRE): I can soft-bump x5 for a 12h window if you confirm times.
Maria (CSE): yes, 2026-04-02 08:00-20:00 UTC.
Sam (Eng): short-term SDK tweak: persist ephemeral to sessionStorage and add an x-rw-session header so tabs share token. example: `const token = sessionStorage.getItem('rw_ephemeral') || await fetchToken(); sessionStorage.setItem('rw_ephemeral', token); fetch('/v1/embeddings', { headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`, 'x-rw-session': 'bf-qa-1' } })`
Jordan (Dev): will add debounce and queued retry with jitter on 429s. backoff ~ retry_after * (1 + rand()).
Evan (SRE): server-side proxy with one long-lived token per session is best if they have SSR.
Sam (Eng): I'll deploy a gateway change to cache preflight for 10s and extend token bind TTL for onboarding keys. should reduce fanout.
Evan (SRE): soft cap increased for BG-1234 x5 from 08:00->20:00 UTC tomorrow, alert RB-4472 created. will auto-revert.
deploy-bot: deployment rwd-gateway@v2.14.3 started by Sam  ref RB-4472.
Sam (Eng): rolling small deploy with preflight cache + session affinity.
Maria (CSE): I will update BlueForge: enable sessionStorage reuse and debounce; confirm after their ramp. :thumbsup:
Evan (SRE): ping here with a span id if 429s persist.
Jordan (Dev): note for SDK release notes: guidance on ephemeral token reuse and retry patterns.
Maria (CSE): closing loop after QA window. thanks everyone :wave:
